audited_source_corrections.action: Restored the formula marker on A in the non-entailment condition.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The preceding and following occurrences use metavariable !A, but this condition writes bare A.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பின்விளையாமை நிபந்தனையில்~$!A$ என்ற வாய்பாட்டு மாறியையே பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating bare A as a different object in one sentence.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The decision procedure constructs a countermodel to the same formula !A throughout.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the non-entailment condition use !A consistently?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the line-3 description from true Diamond and the true-Diamond rule to false Diamond and the false-Diamond rule.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Line 3 in every displayed tree is F Diamond(p and q), and its used-prefix expansion produces F(p and q), but the intervening prose calls it T Diamond and applies the new-prefix T-Diamond rule.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வரி 3 ஐப் பொய்க்குறியிட்ட வைர வாய்பாடாகக் கொண்டு, பொய்-வைர விதியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing all displayed trees and the intended countermodel search to the true-Diamond rule.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The false-Diamond rule must be applied once at every used successor prefix, exactly producing lines 8 and 9.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do the prose sign and rule now match line 3 and its two generated conclusions?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored the original implication direction at the root of the middle tableau.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Only the middle tableau switches its root to Diamond(p and q) implies (Diamond p and Diamond q), while every descendant, the first and third trees, and the countermodel all concern the reverse implication.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மூன்று மரங்களிலும் ஒரே மூல வாய்பாட்டை வைத்துள்ளது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Rebuilding every descendant and changing the example to the valid reverse implication.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The tableau is one successive construction, so its unchanged lines must retain the same root assumption.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do all three diamond tableaux now begin with the same implication?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the cited line-7 signed formula from q at 1.1 to q at 1.2.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The assignment is V(q)={1.2}, line 7 visibly contains T q at 1.2, and the model diagram makes q true at 1.2, but the prose cites 1.1.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வரி 7 ஐ~$\sFmla{\True}{q}[1.2]$ எனத் துல்லியமாக மேற்கோள்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the valuation, tableau line and diagram to 1.1.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The open branch makes p true at 1.1 and q true at 1.2, which is the intended countermodel.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the V(q) explanation now cite q at prefix 1.2?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed both descriptions of the systematic search from construction of a closed tableau to construction of a complete tableau.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Both examples start from underivable formulas and intentionally end with an open complete branch, so their prescribed search cannot be a construction of a closed tableau.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு இடங்களிலும் முழுமையான அட்டவணை மரத்தின் கட்டமைப்பு எனக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Calling the open trees closed; changing both examples to derivable formulas.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The completeness procedure searches exhaustively; closure is one possible outcome, while these examples exhibit the open complete outcome.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are both systematic searches now described as complete-tableau constructions?
